cards.title: Arcade: hide or retire broken first-impression games
cards.desc: Remove public Arcade placement for VoidRush, sky_high_squirt.html stub, duplicate wrapper pages, and any game that fails a mobile smoke test. Acceptance: public Arcade browse shows only playable entries; retired items are documented with rebuild notes.

cards.title: Arcade: keeper game polish pass
cards.desc: Polish the current keeper set: Garden Defense, Bubble Pop Galaxy, Neon Tiles, Arcane Citadel, Gem Match, Pip Bakery Empire, Crypt Crawlers, Cozy Cafe Match, Cozy Biscuit Clicker, Tiger Smash, Stardust Collection. Acceptance: each has clear start, controls, scoring, fail/win state, and no console errors on mobile.

cards.title: Arcade: classify thin prototypes
cards.desc: Audit bread-blocks, dough-dash, pastry-match, star-chef, and nibble-quest. Decision per game: promote, rebuild, merge, or retire. Acceptance: each has a status in GAME_CURATION and no thin prototype appears as a featured game.

cards.title: Arcade: merge redundant match games
cards.desc: Compare candy_kingdom, pastry-match, gem_match, and cozy-cafe-match-game. Keep the strongest two loops, move any good mechanics/art into those, retire the weaker duplicates. Acceptance: Arcade has fewer but stronger match entries.

cards.title: Arcade: repair or replace Sky High Squirt entry
cards.desc: sky_high_squirt.html is only a tiny shell while sky_high_with_friends.html appears to be the real game. Decide which one belongs in Arcade, fix links/cards, and remove the broken-feeling stub. Acceptance: clicking Sky High Squirt opens the complete playable version.

cards.title: Arcade: rebuild VoidRush from retired state
cards.desc: VoidRush is retired pending rebuild. Redesign the first 30 seconds, controls, threat readability, and end state before returning it to the public browse surface. Acceptance: passes mobile smoke and earns Complete or remains Retired.

cards.title: Arcade: add Daily Arcade Run
cards.desc: Add one daily featured game with date seed, score target, streak reward, and leaderboard hook. Acceptance: user sees today cabinet, can play, score persists, and streak increments once per day.

cards.title: Arcade: add cross-game Arcade Quests
cards.desc: Create shared objectives across games: score 500 in any puzzle game, clear 3 waves, win a run without damage, play 3 different genres. Acceptance: quests appear in hub, update after games, and reward XP/profile progress.

cards.title: Arcade: add Remix Spotlight cabinet
cards.desc: Feature one Game Maker creation weekly with Play and Remix actions. Acceptance: featured-games data can mark a spotlight; Arcade card opens play link and remix link cleanly.

cards.title: Arcade: create Boss Rush cabinet
cards.desc: Build a short 90-second action cabinet using existing shooter/wave systems: escalating bosses, one upgrade choice between fights, clear fail/win screen. Acceptance: playable in under two minutes and suitable for Daily Arcade rotation.

cards.title: Arcade: create Tiny Roguelite cabinet
cards.desc: Build a one-screen dungeon cabinet with rooms, keys, simple enemies, and three upgrade choices per floor. Acceptance: 5-minute run, clear upgrade choices, mobile-friendly controls.

cards.title: Arcade: add bronze/silver/gold goals per keeper game
cards.desc: Each keeper game gets three visible goals tied to score, time, survival, or completion. Acceptance: cards show goals and completed goals persist in profile/local storage.

cards.title: Arcade: standardize public game cards
cards.desc: Every public Arcade card needs title, genre, screenshot/visual, controls, session length, status, and mobile smoke date. Acceptance: no card feels like a placeholder or unexplained experiment.

cards.title: Arcade: run automated smoke suite after curation
cards.desc: Use existing Puppeteer audit harnesses where available, plus manual mobile checks for keeper games. Acceptance: result file or doc records pass/fail for each public Arcade entry.

cards.title: Arcade: Power Picks integrated into Game Maker
cards.desc: Completed in the Game Maker app: run-based perk choices, synergies, build HUD, system checks, shared tick wiring, and mobile touch cleanup. Acceptance: 21/21 genre self-test and 99/99 system checks passed in prior browser run.

cards.title: Arcade: final curation decision pass
cards.desc: After the first cleanup, update docs/GAME_CURATION.md with final statuses: Featured, Complete, Experimental, Retired, Standalone, Non-arcade. Acceptance: Arcade browse surfaces match the documented statuses.
